name: @projexlight/sdk-crm
summary: Canonical CRM primitives for ProjexCloud: contacts, leads, deals, activities. Native ProjexCloud system-of-record that can stand alone or sync bidirectionally with Salesforce / HubSpot via the connector SDKs. Foundation for any revops blueprint — sdk-lead-scoring + sdk-campaign + sdk-engagement all reference the entities defined here.

endpoints.description: Fetch a contact + recent activity timeline.
Partial update on a contact; field-level audit emitted.
Convert a lead into a contact + deal (atomic).
Create a deal tied to a contact + amount + stage.

events.name: crm.contact.created.v1
events.description: Contact committed; carries normalized email + dedupe key.

events.name: crm.deal.stage.changed.v1
events.description: Deal moved to a new stage; powers funnel + forecast analytics.

events.name: crm.deal.closed.v1
events.description: Deal closed (won/lost); drives commission + lifecycle workflows.

events.name: crm.activity.logged.v1
events.description: Activity (call / email / meeting / note) logged against a contact or deal.

models.description: Person record: email, phone, company, owner_persona, custom fields.
Pre-qualified prospect; converts to contact + deal.
Opportunity: contact_id, amount, stage, close_date, owner.
Per-activity row: kind, contact_id or deal_id, persona_id, occurred_at, summary.

hooks.name: createContact
hooks.description: Service entry — dedupes against email + phone + the configured fuzzy-match rules.

hooks.name: convertLead
hooks.description: Atomic lead → (contact + deal); idempotent on lead_id.

hooks.name: advanceDeal
hooks.description: Move a deal to a new stage; refuses transitions outside the configured pipeline.

hooks.name: logActivity
hooks.description: Log an activity. Frequently called by sdk-engagement + connector-salesforce on inbound events.

hooks.name: exportToConnector
hooks.description: Push a contact / deal into a registered connector (salesforce, hubspot). Idempotent on the external system's id.

scenarios.title: Inbound webform submit creates / dedupes a contact
scenarios.when_to_use: Marketing webform posts to sdk-crm; we dedupe against email + the configured fuzzy-match before inserting.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns existing contact_id when fuzzy-match hits; emits .contact.created.v1 only on net-new. Audit chain pins the source attribution.

scenarios.title: SDR converts a qualified lead → contact + deal in one call
scenarios.when_to_use: SDR finishes discovery; convertLead atomically creates a contact + opening-stage deal so the AE picks up everything linked.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Both rows created; emits .lead.converted.v1. If the lead's email matches an existing contact, the deal attaches to that contact (no double).

scenarios.title: Move a deal to 'proposal' → triggers commission projection
scenarios.when_to_use: AE updates pipeline stage; advanceDeal validates the transition + emits a stage-change event that sdk-projection consumes for the commission forecast.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Stage advances; emits .deal.stage.changed.v1. Refuses with a structured error if the transition isn't in the configured pipeline.

scenarios.title: Inbound: Salesforce Platform Event creates / updates contact
scenarios.when_to_use: connector-salesforce.webhook.received.v1 with event_type='ContactCreated' — we mirror the new SF Contact into sdk-crm.contact so downstream SDKs (lead-scoring, campaign) see it.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Contact row in sdk-crm mirrors the SF Contact. Future updates flow both ways via sync direction config.

scenarios.title: Push a closed-won deal back to Salesforce
scenarios.when_to_use: Deal closes won in ProjexCloud (e.g. PLG self-serve signup converted by ops); push to SF Opportunity for the rep's quota tracking.
scenarios.expected_outcome: SF Opportunity created or updated; SF id stored on the deal row. Subsequent SF-side edits flow back via the connector.

compliance_posture.notes: Contact data is PII — DSAR / erasure routes through sdk-data-rights which cascades into crm.contact. Owner round-robin respects sdk-rebac territory bounds. Activity log is the GDPR Art-30 record-of-processing for sales interactions.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per push to a registered connector
